// Fixture-generation test source to append to the EXACT released backup.rs.
// Not compiled as part of the normal candidate; see README.md.

#[cfg(test)]
mod released_v031_fixture_generator {
    use super::*;
    use std::env;
    use rusqlite::OptionalExtension;

    #[test]
    fn generate_released_v031_sqlite_fixtures() {
        assert_eq!(rusqlite::version(), "3.53.2", "must use released bundled SQLite");
        let out = PathBuf::from(env::var("BROADCASTER_V031_FIXTURE_OUT").unwrap());
        fs::create_dir_all(&out).unwrap();
    use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
    fs::set_permissions(&out, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700)).unwrap();
        let storage = Storage::at(out.join("released-v031-live.sqlite3"));
        storage.initialize().unwrap();
        {
            let db = storage.connect().unwrap();
            db.execute_batch(
                "INSERT INTO iptv_sources
                   (id,name,origin_kind,origin_locator,enabled,auto_refresh,
                    refresh_interval_seconds,created_at,updated_at)
                   VALUES ('legacy-playlist','Released playlist','remote_url',
                    'https://example.invalid/playlist.m3u',1,1,43200,100,100);
                 INSERT INTO iptv_channels
                   (id,source_id,playlist_order,imported_name,stream_url,
                    tvg_id,created_at,updated_at)
                   VALUES ('legacy-channel','legacy-playlist',0,'Released channel',
                    'https://example.invalid/watch.m3u8','legacy.tvg',100,100);
                 INSERT INTO iptv_channel_overrides
                   (channel_id,display_name_override,updated_at)
                   VALUES ('legacy-channel','Retained channel name',101);
                 INSERT INTO iptv_channel_favourites(channel_id)
                   VALUES ('legacy-channel');
                 UPDATE iptv_view_preferences SET favourites_only=1 WHERE id=1;
                 INSERT INTO epg_sources
                   (id,name,origin_kind,origin_locator,created_at,updated_at)
                   VALUES ('legacy-guide','Released guide','local_file',
                    'file:///nonexistent/epg.xml',100,100);
                 INSERT INTO epg_channels(source_id,channel_id,display_name)
                   VALUES ('legacy-guide','legacy.guide.channel','Guide channel');
                 INSERT INTO epg_programmes
                   (source_id,channel_id,start_utc,stop_utc,title,subtitle)
                   VALUES ('legacy-guide','legacy.guide.channel',120000,121800,
                    'Released programme','Released subtitle');
                 INSERT INTO epg_playlist_links
                   (playlist_source_id,guide_source_id,updated_at)
                   VALUES ('legacy-playlist','legacy-guide',100);
                 INSERT INTO epg_channel_overrides
                   (iptv_channel_id,guide_source_id,guide_channel_id,updated_at)
                   VALUES ('legacy-channel','legacy-guide','legacy.guide.channel',102);
                 INSERT INTO epg_global_id_aliases
                   (guide_source_id,iptv_tvg_id,guide_channel_id,updated_at)
                   VALUES ('legacy-guide','legacy.tvg','legacy.guide.channel',102);
                 UPDATE epg_settings SET shared_guide_source_id='legacy-guide'
                    WHERE singleton=1;"
            ).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                db.query_row("PRAGMA integrity_check", [], |r| r.get::<_, String>(0)).unwrap(),
                "ok"
            );
            assert_eq!(
                db.query_row("PRAGMA foreign_key_check", [], |r| r.get::<_, Option<String>>(0)).optional().unwrap().flatten(),
                None
            );
        }
        let counts = export(&storage, &out.join("released-v031-export.sqlite3")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((counts.playlists, counts.channels, counts.guides), (1, 1, 1));

        // The live SQLite file must be self-contained, not an orphaned WAL image.
        {
            let db = storage.connect().unwrap();
            let mode: String = db.query_row("PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE", [], |r| r.get(0)).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(mode, "delete");
        }
        assert_eq!(
            Storage::at(out.join("released-v031-live.sqlite3"))
              .connect().unwrap()
              .query_row("PRAGMA user_version", [], |r| r.get::<_, i64>(0)).unwrap(), 5
        );
    }
}
